title: Provider Network Standing and the Share Carried into a Rider Benefit Calculation
content:
Whether the provider who gave a line under one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders stands inside or outside the rider's network settles how much of the amount the benefit is taken from is carried into the benefit calculation.

## The rule

Where the line was given by a provider outside the network and the rider held carries an out-of-network share above nil, that share of the amount the benefit is taken from is carried into the benefit calculation. Where the line was given by a provider outside the network and the rider held carries no out-of-network share, nothing is carried into the benefit calculation and no benefit is paid on the line. Otherwise, the line having been given by a provider inside the network, the whole of the amount the benefit is taken from is carried into the benefit calculation.

## The out-of-network share each rider carries

| Rider | Out-of-network share (per cent) |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 50 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 70 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 70 |

The Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider, carrying 0, is the rider that carries no out-of-network share; on the other five the share stands above nil.

## Positive and negative cases, on hypothetical inputs

Take an amount the benefit is taken from of 300.00 USD.

- **Inside the network.** The whole of it is carried into the benefit calculation: 300.00 USD.
- **Outside the network, on a rider carrying a share of 60 per cent.** 60 per cent of 300.00 USD is carried: 180.00 USD.
- **Outside the network, on a rider carrying a share of 70 per cent.** 70 per cent of 300.00 USD is carried: 210.00 USD.
- **Outside the network, on a rider carrying 0.** Nothing is carried into the benefit calculation, and no benefit is paid on the line.

The figure carried is rounded to the nearest cent.
